EmailTemplate.subject: Please complete last week's timesheet in Salesforce
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!EG_Time_Card__c.OwnerFirstName},
Your Salesforce timesheet for last week is incomplete. Please submit complete by no later than end of day.
• Goal is to be accurate—especially on client work—but we are not looking for you to account minute by minute. • If you believe a client project is missing or have any questions about where to log your time, please let Christina W. know.
Complete timesheets here - https://eurasiagroup.lightning.force.com/lightning/n/EG_Timesheets
A guide to internal projects and tasks is available on the Guide to Projects and Tasks in Timesheets.xlsx here - https://eurasiagroup.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/Business%20Development/EbgDxx1SSchFmA5I9Xdl9r8B5_ILALDSeCLLfuFXB8Ljew?e=VaLaTt&ovuser=c5698eff-16b0-4594-92c4-790461230a8b%2Cwehrmann%40eurasiagroup.net&CID=8E8028E2-DBB1-4A98-9979-86189BAD27F9&wdLOR=c9C7477D8-DF49-485F-A5D3-91CFDF4151B1
